_comment: Scoped per-commit mutation gate (coding-standards §12.1/§12.5): mutate ONLY the load-bearing logic THIS change touched, not pre-existing code or DOM writers. Ranges: the two brain-view HTML escapers (boot.js esc, impact.js esc) whose character class grew to cover quotes, closing js/incomplete-html-attribute-sanitization #148-#151. Each escaped character is a separate mutant here, so a class that silently drops one cannot pass. Earlier scopes (trigram.js indexWords/uniqueWords for #153/#154; workflow_graph_lod.js wfgEdgeCoverage, coverage_model.js verdict logic, coverage_indicator.js gatherSources + fmtAge, renderer computeNeighborSet/linkTier, filters buildPredicate, wfgLodTier for issues #35/#36/#41) are unchanged by this diff; their mutation state is recorded in tests/js/MUTATION_NOTES.md.
_comment_vitest: related:false — source: stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/troubleshooting #vitest-failed-to-find-test-files-related-to-mutated-files. The suites load the browser IIFEs into a shared jsdom global instead of importing them, so Stryker 9's related-file tracing finds no tests.
